title: Liu2022 – eldBETA SSVEP benchmark dataset for elderly population
description: The eldBETA dataset contains 64-channel EEG recordings from 100 elderly participants (aged 51-81) performing a 9-target SSVEP-based brain-computer interface speller task. Stimuli used joint frequency and phase modulation (JFPM) at 8-12 Hz in 0.5 Hz steps, with 7 blocks of 9 trials per participant. It serves as a benchmark for evaluating SSVEP-BCI algorithms in an aging population.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz using a Synamps2 amplifier (Neuroscan) with 64 channels, Cz reference, and impedance kept below 20 kOhm. Each trial comprised a 4 s target cue, 5 s of JFPM SSVEP stimulation, and 1 s of rest. Participants completed 7 blocks of 9 trials each.
